g.text: Title: PixelPine - 240 LED charlieplexed PCB Christmas tree

g.desc: Title: PixelPine - 240 LED charlieplexed PCB Christmas tree

g.text: Generated by hardware/scripts/gen_sch.py - edit the script, not this file

g.desc: Generated by hardware/scripts/gen_sch.py - edit the script, not this file

g.text: All LCSC part numbers in the LCSC field of each symbol

g.desc: All LCSC part numbers in the LCSC field of each symbol

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#840000; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#840000; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Scan by anode: phase p (0..15) drives line Lp HIGH, the cathodes of LEDs lit in that phase LOW,

g.desc: Scan by anode: phase p (0..15) drives line Lp HIGH, the cathodes of LEDs lit in that phase LOW,

g.text: all other lines Hi-Z. 16 phases per frame, binary-code-modulated PWM (8 bit, 2 µs slot, 122 Hz).

g.desc: all other lines Hi-Z. 16 phases per frame, binary-code-modulated PWM (8 bit, 2 µs slot, 122 Hz).

g.text: LED Dn+1 sits at board position n (reading order, top->bottom, left->right). Which anode/cathode pair sits at

g.desc: LED Dn+1 sits at board position n (reading order, top->bottom, left->right). Which anode/cathode pair sits at

g.text: which position is chosen by scripts/optimize_leds.py (hardware/led_assignment.json): neighbouring LED pads

g.desc: which position is chosen by scripts/optimize_leds.py (hardware/led_assignment.json): neighbouring LED pads

g.text: share line nets, so each net is a few copper islands joined by tiny bridges and the board routes on 2 layers.

g.desc: share line nets, so each net is a few copper islands joined by tiny bridges and the board routes on 2 layers.

g.text: The star is one electrode on BOTH copper layers, joined by a plated hole. PA7 samples it with

g.desc: The star is one electrode on BOTH copper layers, joined by a plated hole. PA7 samples it with

g.text: ADC charge sharing: hover < light touch < firm press < squeeze (pinched front + back = biggest signal).

g.desc: ADC charge sharing: hover < light touch < firm press < squeeze (pinched front + back = biggest signal).

g.text: PY32F003F18P6 = TSSOP-20 'pinout 1' (datasheet fig. 3-3). SWD via pogo pads TP3 (SWDIO), TP5 (SWCLK),

g.desc: PY32F003F18P6 = TSSOP-20 'pinout 1' (datasheet fig. 3-3). SWD via pogo pads TP3 (SWDIO), TP5 (SWCLK),

g.text: TP6 (NRST), connect-under-reset; after boot the firmware takes PA13/PA14 over as lines L8/L9.

g.desc: TP6 (NRST), connect-under-reset; after boot the firmware takes PA13/PA14 over as lines L8/L9.

g.text: MCU — PY32F003F18P6 + 16 line resistors + touch star

g.desc: MCU — PY32F003F18P6 + 16 line resistors + touch star

g.text: Each row is one charlieplex line driving the ANODES

g.desc: Each row is one charlieplex line driving the ANODES

g.text: (bus wire, line name on the left end of the bus).

g.desc: (bus wire, line name on the left end of the bus).

g.text: Each LED's CATHODE goes to the line named

g.desc: Each LED's CATHODE goes to the line named

g.text: Reference Dn = board position n-1 in reading order

g.desc: Reference Dn = board position n-1 in reading order

g.text: (top -> bottom, left -> right), see the notes above.

g.desc: (top -> bottom, left -> right), see the notes above.

g.text: L0..L15 connect to R1..R16 in the MCU block.

g.desc: L0..L15 connect to R1..R16 in the MCU block.

g.text: LED MATRIX — 240 × XL-1608WWC-06 warm white 0603, charlieplexed on 16 lines

g.desc: LED MATRIX — 240 × XL-1608WWC-06 warm white 0603, charlieplexed on 16 lines

g.text: POWER — USB-C 6-pin, power only, 5 V sink

g.desc: POWER — USB-C 6-pin, power only, 5 V sink

g.text: No fuse / TVS / switch: cost-down decision.

g.desc: No fuse / TVS / switch: cost-down decision.

g.text: Typical draw ≈ 10 mA, max 21 mA @ 5 V.

g.desc: Typical draw ≈ 10 mA, max 21 mA @ 5 V.

g.text: TP1–TP3, TP5, TP6: bare pads on the back for the pogo-pin SWD jig.

g.desc: TP1–TP3, TP5, TP6: bare pads on the back for the pogo-pin SWD jig.

g.text: R1–R16: 100 Ω per charlieplex line (keeps the common anode pin < 20 mA).

g.desc: R1–R16: 100 Ω per charlieplex line (keeps the common anode pin < 20 mA).

g.text: PA7 = ADC: charge-sharing capacitive touch on the star (hover / touch / press / squeeze).

g.desc: PA7 = ADC: charge-sharing capacitive touch on the star (hover / touch / press / squeeze).

g.text: R19 1 kΩ: ESD protection for the exposed star (EN 61547).

g.desc: R19 1 kΩ: ESD protection for the exposed star (EN 61547).

g.text: SWD pins PA13/PA14 double as lines L8/L9: program with connect-under-reset (TP3, TP5, TP6).

g.desc: SWD pins PA13/PA14 double as lines L8/L9: program with connect-under-reset (TP3, TP5, TP6).

g.text: PF4/BOOT0 = line L15: its reset pull-down keeps boot-from-flash; firmware then floats it.

g.desc: PF4/BOOT0 = line L15: its reset pull-down keeps boot-from-flash; firmware then floats it.
